card.title: Obviously One of Us
card.instruction: Act as though effortless acceptance of the bizarre premise proves you belong, and treat visible confusion as a personal risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've saved our invisible guest their usual chair. I remember everything from my trial dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the guest you're putting your coat on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The welcome draping, of course. I wanted my membership dinner to start properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're offering you their coat now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Mutual recognition. Help me find the sleeves; I'd hate to rush such an honour.

mechanism: A reinterprets mistakes around an invisible guest as known ceremony to protect belonging at a membership dinner.
confusable: Unlike straightforward expert certainty, A's smooth acceptance must protect personal insider status when visible confusion threatens it.
comparison: This alternative repairs a coat-placement mistake through claimed ceremony; the cloud-family alternative refuses protection to avoid appearing unfamiliar.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
